taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-01 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1056.4 | 23.97 | 23.97
2 | 1090.4 | 1.46 | 25.43
3 | 2606.8 | 3.17 | 28.60
4 | 3560.6 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-01
Curve type: A-type (resistivity increases progressively with depth: 1056.4 → 1090.4 → 2606.8 → 3560.6 ohm-m)
Aquifer depth: 23.97 – 28.60 m (weathered/fractured zone of moderate resistivity sandwiched between the shallow overburden and the resistive basement)
Recommendation: Target drilling through the 23.97–28.60 m interval, where the fractured/weathered zone offers the best groundwater potential; case off the upper overburden and terminate drilling shortly after penetrating the high-resistivity basement (>3500 ohm-m) at ~28.6 m, as it indicates competent, likely dry bedrock.
